summary: Challenge to complaint under PMLA s.44(1)(b); non-scheduled offences basis: income-tax Act, IPC s. 120B; Pavana Dibbur precedent applied; no valid scheduled offence without conspiracy to commit scheduled offence; 'proceeds of crime' requirement unmet; quashing of complaint proper despite pending cognizance; Writ Petitions 153/2023 and 217/2023 disposed; complaints quashed for Anwar Dhebar and Arun Pati Tripathi; interim order extended three weeks for Writs 153/2023 and 208/2023.
final_judgment: Appeals partly allowed; complaint quashed for Anwar Dhebar in Writ 208/2023 and for Arun Pati Tripathi in Writ 216/2023; Writs 153/2023 and 217/2023 disposed; interim order extended three weeks.
